items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: They had all the OK records by Armstrong and Mammy Smith...

ctx.x: All sorts of good stuff. Oh, yeah.
All these OK records. They had all the OK records by Armstrong and Mammy Smith, Bessie Smith, all the acts of Butterbean and Sousa. He had all those records.

I tried to find those for Tulane, too. And we have quite a few. We have a pretty good collection now. Always looking for more. Speaking of your father, is there anything more you can tell? You didn't tell us much that you said he was musically inclined or something. What, did he sing some or just like music?
